title: Enterprise Connectivity: overage treatment
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following overage treatment for each named contract tier. Treatment of usage exceeding included allowance; string.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | overage treatment | actual measured billing |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the overage treatment is actual measured billing.
